title: Lint options
description: Run non-mutating lint checks. Unset options inherit project configuration and command defaults.

files.title: Files and directories
files.description: Optional project-relative paths. Leave empty to discover the project scope.

linters.title: Linters
linters.description: An empty selection runs all detected linters.

changed.title: Only local changes
changed.description: Select staged, unstaged, and untracked changes, or the runner changeset in CI.

since.title: Changes since ref
since.description: Compare against a ref's merge-base plus local changes. HEAD selects local changes; staged selects the index.

changed-files.title: Explicit changed files
changed-files.description: Union these project-relative paths with the selected change scope.

ignore.title: Ignore file globs
ignore.description: Exclude matching paths from this invocation.

exclude.title: Exclude rules
exclude.description: Rule IDs or patterns, optionally prefixed with a linter name. Does not save suppression configuration.

generated.title: Include generated files
generated.description: Include generated source files. Leave untouched to inherit configured behavior.

baseline.title: Baseline results
baseline.description: Previous results JSON used to report only new violations.

failed.title: Previous failing run
failed.description: Previous results JSON used to rerun failing linters and files.

pr.title: Failed PR checks
pr.description: PR number, repository reference, or URL whose Gavel artifacts select failing linters and files.

schema.title: JSON Schema override
schema.description: Schema path or HTTP(S) URL for the JSON linter. Leave unset to use document declarations.

timeout.title: Per-linter timeout
timeout.description: Duration such as 5m. Leave unset to inherit runtime.timeout, otherwise five minutes.

summary.title: Summarize repeated findings
summary.description: Group findings by linter and rule. Disabling clears the example limit override.

summary-limit.title: Examples per rule
summary-limit.description: Leave unset for the command default of five examples.

dry-run.title: Preview linter commands
dry-run.description: Show the commands without running linters.
